page.overview:
Who is Centipede?

The Centipede is a creature that appeared in "Wizard Battle". It is a monster that came through a portal opened by Dimension Wizard.

The Centipede is a blue centipede-like creature with sixteen legs and nine horns on its back. It has two enormous black eyes and a mouth that resembles a bunch of tentacles. It has pincers on its tail. It bears some features that normal centipedes don't have, such as sky blue skin.
